paragraphs: (G11) (R.I.Grigorchuk, P. de la Harpe) (a) Calculate the growth series of Baumslag-Solitar groups B(p,q) with q>p>1.
(b) Part (a) is probably too hard in general; in fact, it is open even for B(2,3). We single out this case as (allegedly) the most tractable one.
(c) At least, find the asymptotic rates of growth for B(p,q). Background
scope: Three original adjacent paragraphs G11(a),(b),(c), without DOM modification
visual_inspection: Actually viewed on 29 September 2026; all-subparts.png additionally verifies (b) and (c).
